**Finding submitted: deviation (LICENSE — licence grant scope), confidence 0.82.**

What I checked and concluded:

- **Grant clauses (§2.1–2.4, p0030–p0035):** all licences run to **Corio alone**. Our Affiliates are never mentioned and there is no "Affiliate" definition in §1; contractors are only indirectly touched via "Corio Servers … owned or operated by or for Corio" (§1.4). The internal use licence (§2.2) is expressly confined to "Corio's internal business operations."
- **Revocability/term:** already compliant — §2.1 is "perpetual and irrevocable"; §2.2/§2.3 are royalty-free and fully paid up; §11.2 permits termination only for uncured material breach (30-day cure) or insolvency; §11.3 preserves our right to serve then-existing Customers post-termination.
- **Transferability:** §14.1 permits assignment without consent in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all related assets (non-competitor), satisfying the successor-transfer element.

Redline (validated, ok:true): a single new **§2.11 Affiliates and Contractors** inserted after §2.10, extending the Section 2 licences to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, with Corio responsible for their compliance, plus a standard control-based Affiliate definition. This is the minimal edit needed to reach the preferred position — no changes to the term, restrictions or assignment language were required.
